description: Domain intelligence in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA), email security (SPF with lookup count, DMARC policy, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, DKIM on common selectors), registration from RDAP (registrar, created, expires, status, DNSSEC) and the TLS certificate (issuer, expiry). Scored 0-100 with every issue and its fix. Ideal for vetting a vendor, a sender or a lead. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"domain_intel"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/domain?domain=yruz.one

domain.description: domain name (required), e.g. example.com; a URL or email works too
